summary: Accept --as for every fleet transports mutation and attribute its endpoint announcement

replay.detail: Existing endpoint claims retain their meaning.

schema.detail: No database migration or projection change.

rules.detail: Transport mutations use the same caller identity guard as other mutating CLI commands.

compatibility.detail: fleet transports add, remove and prefer accept leading --as and use a public, bound-actor-authorized endpoint. Authorization precedes local effects; publication refusal leaves fleet.toml unchanged. An atomic pending intent retains the mutation ID and target settings until the settings save succeeds, so CLI retry after a lost response reuses the claim idempotency key. Distinct changes record new events. Internal automatic announcements remain actorless and deduplicated.

downtime.detail: Restart on the updated binary; no migration is required.

manual.detail: Agent callers must pass their own literal identity with --as immediately after the transport subcommand. No policy wrapper change is required.

recovery.detail: Binary rollback requires no data conversion.
